data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Had total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: Had
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is my strength
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Had הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Hados', meaning 'God is my strength'. In the New Testament, Had is a variant of the name Athanasius, a famous Christian theologian and doctor of the church.

in_latin.name: Had
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God is my strength
